verdict.rationale: Docs confirm pre-built onboarding Flows covering 'employee and contractor onboarding' (docs-52), employee federal/state tax info collection equivalent to W-4 (docs-37, docs-55), and bank account/payment setup (docs-45), which together cover much of the story. However, there is no explicit mention of I-9 employment eligibility verification or an articulated 'self-serve before day one' onboarding experience in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit I-9 collection support, explicit day-one/self-serve UX description, independent confirmation of the full onboarding flow working end-to-end.
